name: clarion-assistant
description: Clarion language development tools for Claude Code. Skills for Clarion syntax, COM controls, WebView2 components, jFiles JSON, code analysis, and IDE addin development.

clarion-tools.description: Clarion code intelligence with or without the IDE: documentation search across SoftVelocity and installed third-party vendors, CodeGraph indexing and queries, LSP, dictionary and SQL schema tools, knowledge base, file and Everything search. While Clarion is open on the same solution (Clarion Assistant 6.2 or later), also the IDE tools: embed points, the editor, the app tree, builds. Starts with Clarion closed. Requires Clarion Assistant to be installed; the launcher locates the server inside your Clarion tree.
